tools.name: AgentSentinel
tools.inclusion_rationale: AgentSentinel is an eBPF-based LLM agent security monitor from a peer-reviewed venue. Its AuditWithoutTrace mode uses LLM-based safety judgment. Including it demonstrates the incremental value of MtAgentPrism's kernel-level behavioral evidence over LLM-judgment.
